newsitem.title: UK: BTR down after mixed NatWest comment.
newsitem.headline: BTR down after mixed NatWest comment.

text.p: Shares in Britain's BTR Plc continued their retreat from recent highs on Monday after cautious comment on the industrial conglomerate from NatWest Securities, dealers said.
By 1130 GMT BTR shares were down eight pence at 269-1/2 in active volume of 3.4 million shares.
Dealers said NatWest analysts repeated an "add" recommendation on the stock but said that it could make sense to take profits in the short term. Analysts at the brokerage declined comment.

"NatWest has an "add" note out this morning, but it says this might be a time for profit-taking after their good run," one market maker said. Dealers said there seemed to be no other reason for BTR's fall.
After setting a close of 230-1/2p on December 5, their lowest in over two years, BTR shares rallied sharply to close at 284p on December 31.
